Says how long a frame of an animated picture lasts, in milliseconds, so that a program can step through the frames at the speed that the file asks for. [LoadAnimTexture](LoadAnimTexture) with a frame size of 0 loads GIF, animated WebP and animated AVIF files this way. A frame that the file gives no time (or 0) lasts 100 milliseconds, like in web browsers.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
anim = LoadAnimTexture("spinner.gif", 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)
frame = 0 : next_change = MilliSecs() + TextureFrameDelay(anim, 0)
While Not KeyHit(1)
	If MilliSecs() >= next_change Then
		frame = (frame + 1) Mod TextureFrames(anim)
		next_change = MilliSecs() + TextureFrameDelay(anim, frame)
	EndIf
	; EntityTexture entity, anim, frame
Wend
```

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals cannot load animated pictures.
@param texture  The texture to ask about.
@param frame    The frame, from 0.
@returns The time in milliseconds, or 0 for a texture that is not from an animated picture or a frame that it does not have.
